beats.subline: Friday, October 30, 2026 close — a rough finish to a volatile earnings week, as Big Tech's AI-spending jitters overcame the Fed's rate hold and a strong GDP report.
beats.body: The week opened with the Fed holding rates steady and Oracle surging on its long-term revenue outlook, but Wednesday night's Alphabet post-earnings plunge reignited AI capital-spending worries that spread to Amazon and Intel by Friday; third-quarter GDP growth accelerated to 3.4% and oil pushed back toward $100 a barrel on US-Iran tensions.

beats.headline: Netanyahu calls Israeli election result 'stolen' as final count leaves no bloc with a majority
beats.body: Israel's final tally gave Netanyahu's bloc 53 seats to the opposition's 48 - short of the 61 needed to govern - while Arab parties won a record 19; Netanyahu said the vote was 'stolen by Arab parties that support terrorism and the elimination of the Jewish state' and called for an investigation, a dispute Washington is watching closely as it works to keep Israel aligned on Iran policy.

beats.headline: Trump and Rubio say more Iran strikes remain possible but unlikely before the midterms
beats.body: Trump said the US could eliminate Iran's remaining nuclear sites 'in ten minutes,' but Rubio said no decision has been made, with officials signaling new strikes are unlikely before next week's midterms; Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei separately ordered commanders to update target lists to include 'all tangible and intangible assets' tied to the US and Israel, even as Foreign Minister Araghchi floated a two-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz that Washington has not accepted.

beats.headline: Bears' Jeffery Simmons set for his first prime-time appearance since 2023 Monday at Seattle
beats.body: Simmons, acquired from Tennessee last week, is expected to be in the Bears' lineup wearing No. 99 when the 5-2 Bears visit the defending Super Bowl champion Seahawks on Monday Night Football; Chicago is counting on the interior pass rusher's double-team attention to free up Montez Sweat and Grady Jarrett, with Caleb Williams healthy at quarterback.
